{{Top|leg}}
The '''Brentaal Hall Conservatory''' was a well-known [[Music/Legends|musical]] company, which included the [[Conservatory Epic Orchestra]] and the [[Brentaal Illustrious Choir]]. The Conservatory provided members to the production of an extravagant performance of ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWAJ13">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
